title: World Forum for Democracy 2026 -- Youth Delegation
description: The Council of Europe's World Forum for Democracy Youth Delegation brings up to 50 young people from around the world to Strasbourg, France to bring a youth perspective to the 14th World Forum for Democracy, themed "Rupture or Renewal? Democratic Security for Our Future" as part of the New Democratic Pact for Europe. Selected delegates take part in online preparatory sessions (September-October 2026), an in-person training of the youth delegation (31 October-1 November), the World Forum for Democracy itself (2-3 November), and the dedicated Youth Day (4 November). The Council of Europe covers travel and visa costs per its applicable rules, with accommodation and meals provided at the European Youth Centre Strasbourg; there is no cash stipend. Applicants must be 18-30 years old, able to work independently in English, available for the entire program including the online preparatory period, and represent a youth organisation or movement active on democracy, youth participation, or democratic innovation. Deadline to apply: 14 August 2026, 14:00 Strasbourg time.
visaNote: This is short-term forum attendance, not employment; the Council of Europe covers travel and visa costs per its own rules for confirmed participants.
